title: Graphic & Motion Designer -Performance Marketing
description:
**Graphic \& Motion Designer – Performance Marketing**  
**Experience**: 1–2 Years  
**Location**: Nerul, Navi Mumbai  
**Work Mode**: On\-site Employment  
**Type**: Full\-time

**About the Role** :  
We are looking for a **Graphic \& Motion Designer** who understands that great performance creatives need to do more than just look good — they need to **grab attention, communicate quickly, and drive clicks and conversions.**  
You’ll work closely with our marketing and content teams to create high\-performing static and motion creatives across Meta, Google, marketplaces and other digital platforms.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Design **performance marketing ads** for Meta, Google and other paid digital channels.
* Create static ads, carousels, banners, GIFs, short\-form videos and motion graphics.
* Develop multiple creative variations for **A/B testing**, including different hooks, layouts, CTAs and messaging.
* Turn product benefits, customer pain points, offers and campaign ideas into strong visual concepts.
* Edit short\-form ad videos, UGC\-style creatives, product videos and social content.
* Add motion graphics, typography, transitions and effects to improve ad engagement.

Adapt winning creatives into different formats, sizes and platforms.

* Work closely with the performance marketing team to understand **CTR, conversions and creative performance.**
* Analyse which creatives are working and continuously improve designs based on performance data.
* Stay updated with current advertising, social media, motion design and D2C creative trends.

Maintain band consistency while experimenting with new creative directions

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 1–2 years of experience in **Graphic Design, Motion Design or Performance Marketing Creatives.**
* Strong understanding of creating ads for **digital and social media platforms.**
* Good sense of typography, hierarchy, composition, colour and visual storytelling.
* Ability to create both **static and motion creatives.**
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple campaigns and creative iterations.
* Ability to understand briefs quickly and translate them into visually strong, conversion\-focused creatives.
* A portfolio showcasing digital ads, social media creatives, motion graphics or video editing work.

**Tools**   
Hands\-on experience with:

* Adobe Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Figma
* Knowledge of additional AI/design/video tools is a plus

**Bonus** **If You**   
1\. Have worked with a **D2C, e\-commerce or consumer brand.**  
2\. Understand concepts like **CTR, ROAS, CAC, hooks and creative testing.**  
3\.Have experience creating UGC\-style ads or product\-focused video creatives.  
4\. Can identify performance creative trends and quickly adapt them for a brand.

If you enjoy combining **design, motion and marketing psychology** to create ads that perform, we’d love to hear from you.

**Location**: Nerul, Navi Mumbai  
**On\-site** Experience: 1–2 Year

**To Apply**: Share your resume and portfolio to hr\\@oracura.in showcasing your best static ads, motion graphics and performance marketing creatives.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Motion Graphics Designer
description:
FlytBase


Create AI\-native motion graphics, animations, and video content end\-to\-end for social, product, and campaigns, using AI tools, 3D, and editing workflows while building scalable motion systems and templates.


Marketing
 Pune, India (Onsite)
 Full\-time
 2
  
### **What We Do**


FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies. With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


We're looking for a motion graphics designer who can jump in and start producing from day one—this is a working role, not a shadowing one. You'll be handed real briefs for product explainers, social content, and campaign videos, and expected to take them from concept to final render with the design team's support, not their supervision. You'll also be expected to use AI video and animation tools as part of your everyday workflow to move fast. If you need heavy hand\-holding to get started, this isn't the right fit—but if you're ready to own tasks end\-to\-end and learn on the job by actually doing the job, this is for you.
### **What You'll Own**


• AI\-Native Motion: Use tools like Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Veo 2, and AnimateDiff as part of your daily workflow to generate and refine motion assets. • Multi\-Format Animation: Independently produce motion graphics for social content, product explainers, ads, and internal videos, start to finish. • Storytelling: Turn product and technical ideas into clear, compelling animated content with minimal briefing. • 3D \& Editing: Animate and composite 3D renders and video edits for live campaigns. • Reusable Systems: Use and help build motion templates and design systems the team relies on.
### **Best Suited For**


• Working proficiency in After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent)—comfortable enough to execute independently, not just follow tutorials. • Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video/motion tool, or the ability to pick one up and be productive within days. • A reel of real work—personal, freelance, or college projects—that shows you can take an idea through to a finished, polished piece on your own. • Solid grasp of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling fundamentals. • Comfortable taking a brief and running with it, asking sharp questions instead of waiting to be told each step. • You've seen every corner of Pinterest and have curated boards for all your visual ideas.
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• AI\-first mindset: You already reach for AI tools to move faster, not just when told to. • Ready to ship: You can take a task from brief to final output without needing it broken down for you. • Ownership without oversight: You manage your own tasks and flag blockers early instead of waiting. • High trust, high candor: You give and receive sharp feedback early. • Reliable: You follow through on what you commit to, on time.
### **What We Don't Want**


• Designers looking for a resume line with no real involvement. • People who need step\-by\-step hand\-holding to get started on a task. • Those who avoid AI tools or treat them as optional. • Anyone who confuses hours worked with value created.
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you're done with roles where junior means low\-impact work, and you're ready to own real deliverables that shape how the world sees drone autonomy—show us what you've shipped and why it worked.
